calls.reason: The packet has no record of this child's arithmetic and no matched test against a named model. The Faith and Fate paper covers model weaknesses only and says nothing about the child.

Studies from 2023 (Faith and Fate, and AgentBench's instruction-following and open-model failures) show unreliable general performance. No evidence shows any system reaching human-level reliability across tasks.

Valmeekam et al. support weak planning, with GPT-4 near 34% on Blocksworld. But the main inference, that key ingredients are uninvented, is untested, and the hallucination and Othello-GPT studies cut against it.
OpenAI itself said GPT-4 was not fully reliable, and even the Sparks paper calls it an early, incomplete form of AGI that lacks planning. That falls well short of human-comparable reliability.
The BCG experiment shows usefulness on some tasks. But nothing in the packet compares a representative set of public claims with real-world reliability, so the overstatement part can't be judged.
SugarCrepe found 2023 vision-language models trailing humans by 27–50% on swaps people find easy. Segment Anything's gains are limited to segmentation and don't show general visual understanding.
